english: Let $\overrightarrow{a}$ and $\overrightarrow{b}$ be vectors with $|\overrightarrow{a}|=2$ and $|\overrightarrow{b}|=3$, where the angle between $\overrightarrow{a}$ and $\overrightarrow{b}$ may take any value in $[0,\pi]$. Then the maximum value of $|\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{b}|^{2}+2|\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b}|^{2}$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $\overrightarrow{a}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{b}$ ऐसे सदिश हैं कि $|\overrightarrow{a}|=2$ तथा $|\overrightarrow{b}|=3$ है, जहाँ $\overrightarrow{a}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{b}$ के बीच का कोण $[0,\pi]$ में कोई भी मान ले सकता है। तब $|\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{b}|^{2}+2|\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b}|^{2}$ का अधिकतम मान ______ है।
solution: $p=2\in[-6,6]$ is attained, so the maximum is $66$
solution_full: Let $p=\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}=6\cos\theta$, where $\theta\in[0,\pi]$ is the angle between the vectors, so $p$ takes every value in $[-6,6]$.
$E$ is largest when $(p-2)^2$ is smallest; $p=2$ lies in $[-6,6]$ (it corresponds to $\cos\theta=\dfrac13$).
originality_note: New: a quadratic in a.b built from a cross-product magnitude and a dot-product magnitude, maximised over the angle; the vertex must be checked to lie in the attainable range (way 5). Closest known: maximum of |pa + qb| or of 3|3a+2b|+4|3a-2b| (JEE Main 2026). Different because: Lagrange's identity converts the cross term into -p^2, so the expression is an exact quadratic in a.b with an interior maximum.

concept_use.Lagrange’s Identity in Vectors: |a x b|^2 = 36 - (a.b)^2 turns the cross-product term into a function of p = a.b.
concept_use.Application of dot product: |a+b|^2 = 13 + 2 a.b, and p = 6 cos theta ranges over [-6, 6], which decides that the vertex p = 2 is attained.

stem_review: Read as a student: every vector, line and point is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy and numpy, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Stated the range of the angle so that the maximum is over all relative positions. Changed: added 'the angle ... may take any value in [0, pi]'.
key_step: Expressing both terms in p = a.b (Lagrange and the dot expansion) and completing the square.
justification: Routine three-step chain: Lagrange's identity, dot expansion, vertex of a quadratic with a range check. Matches the routine vector chain of 2026-P2-Q1 (L2).
